name: Nimanbun no Ichi no Amatsubutachi - One in 20,000 raindrops
original_name: 二万分の一の雨粒達 - One in 20,000 raindrops
source:
Satoshi Kuga, who leads an isolated high school life with a cynical attitude, is dreading the school trip starting tomorrow. This is because he has been assigned to the same group as the popular clique in his class, who are enjoying their youth to the fullest. However, it seems there are hidden tensions within this seemingly close-knit group, and he gradually finds himself drawn into their problems.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4800570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
以愤世嫉俗的态度过着与世隔绝的高中生活的久贺智，对明天开始的修学旅行感到恐惧。因为他和班里的小红派分到了同一组，正尽情享受着青春。然而，这个看似紧密的团体中似乎隐藏着紧张关系，他逐渐发现自己陷入了他们的问题之中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4800570/]Steam[/url]]
